```sql
SELECT 
    kpi_id,
    company_id,
    basis,
    status,
    COUNT(*) AS period_count
FROM kpi_values
GROUP BY kpi_id, company_id, basis, status
ORDER BY kpi_id, company_id, basis, status;
```

## 3. Conflict Policy Rule Table (R1 to R12)

Exact outcome-changed counts matching docs/CONFLICT_POLICY.md:


| Rule ID | Rule Name | Description | Rows Changed Outcome | Unit Test Verification |

| :---: | :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |

| **R1** | Amendment Supersedes Original | 10-Q/A restatements supersede original 10-Q figures | **14** | `test_r1_amendment_supersedes` |

| **R2** | Full-Year 10-K Q4 Derivation | Derive Q4 as $FY - (Q1+Q2+Q3)$ when Q4 unstated | **24** | `test_r2_q4_derivation` |

| **R3** | Unit Scale Standardization | Correct HBS 1,000x unit mislabeling ($M vs $K) | **11** | `test_r3_unit_scale_correction` |

| **R4** | Accounting Sign Standardization | Force positive convention for expenses/COGS (ABS) | **72** | `test_r4_sign_standardization` |

| **R5** | Deduplication via Canonical Priority | Retain canonical row, link duplicate via duplicate_of_id | **2** | `test_r5_deduplication` |

| **R6** | Strict No-Zero-Fill for Absent Items | Mark `missing_input` instead of COALESCE(val, 0) | **48** | `test_r6_no_zero_fill` |

| **R7** | Non-Applicable Ratio Sentinel | Set `not_applicable` for meaningless denominators | **0** | `test_r7_not_applicable_sentinel` |

| **R8** | Multi-Source Tie-Breaking | Auditor-certified 10-K/Q over investor presentations | **0** | `test_r8_source_tie_breaking` |

| **R9** | Date Format Standardization | ISO 8601 normalization (MM/DD/YYYY to YYYY-MM-DD) | **96** | `test_r9_date_normalization` |

| **R10** | Foreign Currency Translation | Reject non-USD without explicit FX rate table | **0** | `test_r10_foreign_currency_sentinel` |

| **R11** | Calendar Quarter Re-alignment | Map 4-4-5 / non-standard fiscal ends to canonical quarters | **0** | `test_r11_fiscal_quarter_realignment` |

| **R12** | Discontinued Operations Isolation | Isolate continuing operations income from net income | **0** | `test_r12_discontinued_operations` |


> [!NOTE]

> **Zero-Trigger Rules (R7, R8, R10, R11, R12)**: These rules fired 0 times on the current 6-company dataset because:

> - R7: No company reported exactly $0 or negative denominator in balance sheet ratios.

> - R8: No conflicting investor slide deck was ingested that contradicted SEC 10-K filings.

> - R10: All filings in Drop 1 and Drop 2 were USD denominated.

> - R11: All 6 companies followed standard calendar quarter ends.

> - R12: No company reported discontinued operations line items in this dataset.

> Each zero-trigger rule is backed by an automated unit test in `tests/unit/test_kpi_calculator.py` verifying correct behavior when triggered.
